Uebersicht.title: Overview
Uebersicht.body: The landing page of your books: a wall of key figures, each with its value, its as-of date and a path into the surface behind it. Everything is computed in the engine; this page only composes. A tile whose module is not set up moves behind the further-tiles hint instead of showing a fake zero. You pick the range at the top; an arrangement can be saved as a view and recalled.
